verdicts.citation: CONTRACTS.md 4 (worker message, serialization, 'errors re-thrown on the main side as the same class'); SPEC.md 5.1 E-9 item 3 (Satake data for E7 and E8 in the worker); RT-03 lens attack 22
verdicts.evidence: HEAD f07eec66a8b80d249101630305ef6d2d23882738, detached. npm ci done once, as above. Removed the previous finding's file, then applied only site/tests/unit/redteam-RT-03-p6-worker-wire.test.ts from worktree-agent-aaf7a474ed3a7598c. It is absent at the gate and present on the branch, and it imports nothing under redteam/. status --porcelain: 'A  site/tests/unit/redteam-RT-03-p6-worker-wire.test.ts'. Ran from <wt>: TMPDIR=<scratch>/verify-p6-rt03-reproduce/tmp-wire npx vitest run --project site-unit redteam-RT-03-p6-worker-wire. Exit 1, 'Tests  4 failed | 5 passed (9)'. Failed: 'E7 e7(-133)', 'E8 e8(-24)', 'E8 e8(-248)', 'restrictedBoard of the compact form of E8 (no white node) resolves or rejects within 2 s'. E7 e7(-133) and E8 e8(-248): 'AssertionError: NotABoard: an adjacency matrix needs at least one node: expected false to be true'. E8 e8(-24): main thread gives labels [4,3,2,1] with Cartan rows [-1,2,-2,0] and [0,-1,2,-1]; the wire gives labels [1,2,3,4] with rows [-1,2,-1,0] and [0,-2,2,-1]. n 4 and name F4 are the same on both sides. Compact form: received {settled: 'pending after 2 s', uncaught: ['NotABoard: an adjacency matrix needs at least one node']}, expected {settled: 'resolved', uncaught: []}. Because the 2 s race depends on timing, I ran it a second time (load 20.7, fresh TMPDIR tmp-wire2): exit 1, the same 4 failures, the same 'pending after 2 s' and the same NotABoard. At the gate commit, site/src/lib/worker.ts onmessage reads 'if (reply.ok) p.resolve(deserialize(reply.result));' with no catch, as the location says. Observed matches the finding in every value. Tree after the run: only the applied file, which I then removed before the next finding.
verdicts.reason: reproduced as stated; observed matches in both runs: restrictedBoard of e7(-133) and e8(-248) fails to deserialize with NotABoard, e8(-24) comes back with labels [1,2,3,4] and a Cartan different from the main thread's [4,3,2,1] board, and engineCall on compact E8 is still pending after 2 s with an uncaught NotABoard. The rubric does not clearly name the case: the 'same class' and 'same result' requirements are CONTRACTS 4 text, and SPEC E-9 item 3 says only that these calls run 'in a Web Worker behind a promise', so the claimed minor is left as is.
